Definition: an Uzzielite (collectively) or descendants of Uzziel
BiblicalUsage: The Uzzielites were a family of the Levites, the sons of Uzziel, the son of Kohath, numbered among those who served in the house of God and kept the charge of the sanctuary.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that the Uzzielites are the family that kept the holy things: they carried the ark and the vessels, and their name is written among the Levites.
